title: [Re] Augmented Neural ODEs: code and per-seed results
description:
Reimplementation and replication of Augmented Neural ODEs (Dupont, Doucet and Teh, NeurIPS 2019), together with four supporting claims about solver cost and adjoint memory from Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Chen et al., NeurIPS 2018), written for ReScience C.

This archive holds the implementation, the per-seed result files behind every number in the article, and the scripts that rebuild every figure from them. Every measurement carries a reconstruction check, so no quantity is reported at a solver tolerance that does not integrate the flow.
